summary: Updates clinical-lab-harmonization skill with thyroid panel conversion factors (Free_T4, Free_T3, Total_T4, Total_T3) and critical CSV parsing guidance for quoted comma-decimals. The trace revealed the agent struggled with quoted European decimals (e.g., "7,2882") being misparsed by naive CSV splitting, and required specific molecular conversion factors for thyroid hormones that differ from standard electrolyte panels.
